title: cstr operation
description: Continuous stirred-tank reactor. Reactor volume is the only parameter; temperature is taken from the feed stream.

V_R.title: Reactor volume
V_R.description: Total liquid volume held in the CSTR.

thermalMode.title: Thermal mode
thermalMode.description: isothermal (default; `T` holds and the duty is the result), adiabatic (the energy balance sets T), or heatExchange (a jacket removes UA·(T − T_coolant)). Any other word is REFUSED.

T.title: Reactor temperature
T.description: The held temperature in isothermal mode; defaults to the feed temperature.

T_guess.title: Temperature seed
T_guess.description: First guess for the energy-balance Newton. NOT cosmetic: an adiabatic or jacketed CSTR can have up to THREE steady states, and the Newton lands on the one this seed is nearest — sweep it to find them all. An explicit, author-owned aid, in the no-silent-crutch sense.

UA.title: Jacket UA
UA.description: Overall coefficient times area for the jacket. Required by `thermalMode heatExchange`.

catalystLoading.title: Catalyst loading
catalystLoading.description: Mass of catalyst per unit reactor volume, for a rate expressed per kg of catalyst.
